forcing: PCG64 seed from first16 SHA256 bytes, little-endian, of compact JSON [namespace,stage,*key,0,generation,purpose,channel]. Channel injury gives a uniform permutation of the244 non-port cells; take first18 or24. Channel forcing gives2049x2x16x16 normal draws. Exclude injury count, policy and noise regime from seed. Matched copies cue0 birth/noise to cue1; independent keeps both. All policies share forcing and evolve their own packets.
storage: Protected incoming packet and candidate successor, supplied task/reader/writer/cue apparatus. Charge current native read and candidate construction even when promotion is declined; report logical promotion and unavoidable-read costs separately.

cohort.selection: First16 eligible acquisition blocks in ascending ID, acquired in complete8-block waves. Use original key-hash/rule-balanced boundary selector; require exactly2 original failures and2 successes. Retain all attempts and surplus blocks. No futures until entire cohort is committed.

primary.endpoint: Fraction of original-rule successes over g16..33, averaged within4 packets and then across16 acquisition blocks.
primary.criterion: All six one-sided95% paired acquisition-block t lower limits must exceed zero: guard beats always-promote and protected-retain under independent noise at both injuries; guard-minus-always benefit is larger under independent than matched noise at both injuries. One conjunctive claim; individual intervals are not simultaneous.
primary.decision: SUPPORTED only if all six lower limits>0 with nonzero block variance; CONTRADICTED if any nondegenerate upper95% one-sided limit<=0; otherwise UNRESOLVED. All strict point directions also reported separately, without rescuing inference.
primary.assumptions: Independent acquisition blocks, fixed conditional boundary-selection estimand, and approximate t inference across16 block contrasts. The paired policies, injuries and noise regimes are not independent founders.

secondary: All four policies, both historical classes, terminal and uninterrupted success, opposite-rule occupancy, promotion counts, and all ordered policy contrasts. The previous history-guard primary and injury-crossover failures remain closed.
qualification: One8-worker mixed wave: three fresh disposable full acquisitions, one full legacy g1..14 replay byte-matched to exposed archive, and four disposable full four-policy continuation units. Exact native equations and complete native/flat/policy checks. Timing must allow all24 acquisition attempts and all32 target continuations within3000seconds, with120seconds reserve.
exposure: Hypothesis, sample size and endpoint motivated by exposed guard continuation. Acquisition, selection and future namespaces are fresh and the frozen design predates them. Same programme; not external preregistration, RDT-specific validation, or a general biological law.
